name: derived_down_refuses_type_change
comment: ADR-0018: a same-column type change between adjacent snapshots is not derivable; migrate down refuses with MIG-020 (override Down() by hand). down_missing.json covers the other refusal: no snapshots at all.

up: create table widgets (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, price TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT
alter table widgets rename to widgets_old
create table widgets (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, price INTEGER NOT NULL) STRICT
insert into widgets select id, cast(price as INTEGER) from widgets_old
